==================
Simple function definition
==================

func hello
    see "Hello from function" + nl

---

(source_file
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    (see_statement
      (binary_expression
        (string)
        (identifier)))))

==================
Function with parentheses call
==================

hello()

func hello
    see "Hello from function" + nl

---

(source_file
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      (identifier)))
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    (see_statement
      (binary_expression
        (string)
        (identifier)))))

==================
Function return value
==================

func fact x if x = 1 return 1 else return x * fact(x-1) ok

---

(source_file

    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (arguments
        (number))))
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (param_list
      (identifier))
    (if_statement
      condition: (binary_expression
        (identifier)
        (number))
      (return_statement
        (number))
      (else_clause
        (return_statement
          (binary_expression
            (identifier)
            (call_expression
              (identifier)
              (arguments
                (binary_expression
                  (identifier)
                  (number))))))))))

==================
Multiple functions
==================

first()  second()

        (identifier))))

    name: (identifier)

      (binary_expression
        (string)
        (identifier)))))

==================
First class functions
==================

Func Main
    f = Test2(:Test)
    call f()

Func Test
    see "Message from test!" + nl

Func Test2 f1
    call f1()
    return f1

---

(source_file
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    (expression_statement
      (assignment_expression
        (identifier)
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (arguments
            (symbol
              (identifier))))))
    (expression_statement
      (call_keyword_expression
        (call_expression
          (identifier)))))
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    (see_statement
      (binary_expression
        (string)
        (identifier))))
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (param_list
      (identifier))
    (expression_statement
      (call_keyword_expression
        (call_expression
          (identifier))))
    (return_statement
      (identifier))))

==================
Higher order functions
==================

Func Main
    times(5,:test)

Func Test
    see "Message from the test function!" + nl

Func Times nCount,F
    for x = 1 to nCount
        Call F()
    next

---

(source_file
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    (expression_statement
      (call_expression
        (identifier)
        (arguments
          (number)
          (symbol
            (identifier))))))
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    (see_statement
      (binary_expression
        (string)
        (identifier))))
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (param_list
      (identifier)
      (identifier))
    (for_statement
      variable: (identifier)
      (number)
      (identifier)
      (expression_statement
        (call_keyword_expression
          (call_expression
            (identifier)))))))

==================
Pass parameters using lists
==================

myconnect (  [ :server = "myserver.com" , :port = 80 ,
               :username = "mahmoud" , :password = "password" ] )

func myconnect mypara
    see "User Name : " + mypara[:username] + nl

---

(source_file

      (identifier)

            (symbol
              (identifier))
            (number))
          (hash_pair
            (symbol
              (identifier))
            (string))
          (hash_pair
            (symbol
              (identifier))
            (string))))))
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (param_list
      (identifier))
    (see_statement
      (binary_expression
        (binary_expression
          (string)
          (subscript_expression
            (identifier)
            (symbol
              (identifier))))
        (identifier)))))

==================
Pass lists to function by reference
==================

func main
    aList = [1,2,3,4,5]
    myfunc(aList)
    see aList

func myfunc list
    list + [6,7,8,9,10]

---

(source_file
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    (expression_statement
      (assignment_expression
        (identifier)
        (list_literal
          (number)
          (number)
          (number)
          (number)
          (number))))
    (expression_statement
      (call_expression
        (identifier)
        (arguments
          (identifier))))
    (see_statement
      (identifier)))
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (param_list
      (identifier))
    (expression_statement
      (binary_expression

          (number)
          (number)
          (number)
          (number)
          (number))))))

==================
Typed parameters
==================

func sum(int x, int y) {
    return x + y
}

---

(source_file
  (function_definition
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (param_list
      (typed_parameter
        type: (identifier)
        name: (identifier))
      (typed_parameter
        type: (identifier)
        name: (identifier)))
    (return_statement
      (binary_expression
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))))
